name: vc-tools
description: Virto Commerce internal QA tooling, published as a Claude Code marketplace for VC customers running the VC platform.

plugins.name: vc-fix
plugins.description: Bug lifecycle for Virto Commerce QA — project setup, bug filing, autonomous fixing, fix verification, online bug monitoring, and self-diagnostics (/vc-self-check). Self-contained plugin (10 agents, 16 skills, 8 commands).

plugins.name: vc-kb
plugins.description: The Virto Commerce knowledge base — a CLI (`kb`) that extracts REST + GraphQL contracts from a running deployment and answers questions against them plus the observations agents captured while working. Reads and writes a separate base repository (VirtoCommerce/vc-knowledge) whose location is declared, never discovered. Zero runtime dependencies. Not enabled by default: it is inert without a base.

plugins.name: vc-perf
plugins.description: Three-layer performance loop — BenchmarkDotNet A/B (L1), k6 load harness (L2), dotnet-trace allocation/CPU/DB attribution (L3), machine-readable perf-verdict, optimization PRs. Depends on vc-fix (reuses its onboarding, routing, and backend dev/review agents). Advisory only.
